acceptanceCriteria.text: Replaying claim_kanban_card with the same idempotencyKey returns the attempt id (claimToken null), matching claim_ticket

An orchestrator can release a claimed card attempt whose token was lost (fail_kanban_card by attemptId without claimToken, as fail_attempt allows), and the card can then be claimed again without another Play
The dm CLI writes its JSON output to stdout when run from Windows PowerShell, or the CLI runbook and the injected chat instructions say to run it from Git Bash
Tests cover the replay, the tokenless release and the reclaim

body: When an orchestrator calls claim_kanban_card and the response never reaches it, the card has no recovery path. In practice: the dm CLI (DarkMechanicus.exe + cli.js) run from Windows PowerShell 5.1 printed nothing to stdout (Electron GUI-subsystem exe; the same call under Git Bash prints JSON), yet the claim succeeded. A repeat claim then fails with already_claimed, the token is shown once and cannot be recovered, there is no agent-callable way to release the attempt (fail_kanban_card needs the claimToken), and after the lease expires claim_kanban_card needs a fresh Play from the desktop. Seen on DM-420, attempt #1. Tickets have a recovery path (an idempotency-key replay returns the attempt, then fail_attempt works without a token); Kanban cards need the same.
title: Lost Kanban claim response strands the card until a person presses Play again
